verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਅਸਮਾਣ ਉਚਾਣਿ ਚੜਿ ਉਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਿ ਸਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh asamaan uchaan chaR uchaa hoi na a(n)baR sakai|

en.bdb: Even mounting the lakhs of sky none can reach that highest Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਚੀ ਹੂ ਊਚਾ ਘਣਾ ਥਾਉ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਅਥਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: auchee hoo uoochaa ghanaa thaau giraau na naau athakai|

en.bdb: He is higher than the highest; He has no (particular) place, residence, name and any fatigue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਤਾਲ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਜਾਇ ਨੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਨੀਵੈ ਤਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh pataal neevaan jai neevaa hoi na neevai takai|

en.bdb: If someone goes low equal to millions of netherworlds even then he cannot behold Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਪਛਮਿ ਉਤਰਾਧਿ ਦਖਣਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਢਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: poorab pachham utaraadh dhakhan fer chaufer na ddakai|

en.bdb: Even the covers of all the four directions - north, east, south, west, cannot over Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਕ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: oRak mool na labhiee utapat paralau akh farakai|

en.bdb: His expanse cannot be attained; He by one wink of His eye can create and dissolute (the whole cosmos).
As the fragrance adorns the flower, the Lord also is present everywhere.
